events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first broadcasted music video.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Remember when music videos changed everything? Forty-five years ago today, MTV launched, and The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' ushered in a new era. Did it really kill the radio star, though?

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album, 'Definitely Maybe,' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, Oasis unleashed 'Definitely Maybe' on the world. This album wasn't just a debut; it was a statement. What's your favourite track from this Britpop classic?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, the Woodstock Festival kicked off a weekend of peace, love, and music. Imagine being there! Which iconic performance would you have loved to see?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977. He would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, we lost the King, Elvis Presley. His music and legacy continue to inspire generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas. He would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a legend. Today, we remember Tupac Shakur, whose powerful lyrics and artistry continue to resonate. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970. He would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we said goodbye to a true guitar icon, Jimi Hendrix. His innovative sound changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road,' on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road.' That album cover, those songs... pure genius. What's your top track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders have always been unmistakable. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite lyric delivered by the Oasis legend?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic song 'Imagine' as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975. The album was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first time you put '1,000 songs in your pocket'? Twenty-five years ago, Apple unveiled the original iPod, changing how we listen to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No,' on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit screens, sparking a global phenomenon. What's your all-time favourite Bond film, theme song, or gadget?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we remember John Lennon, who would have turned 86. His impact on music and culture is immeasurable. What's the John Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday Humour
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles delivered 'The White Album,' a sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. Which track from this iconic double album is your absolute favourite?
